snippet.title: FORMIDO | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3913230/FORMIDO/

Wander through hauntingly beautiful environments with two unlikely companions: Amy, a mysterious armored girl, and Roka, a lovable yet eerie monster. In this narrative-driven experience, your bond with each companion subtly shapes the final narration.

There’s no combat. No death. Just unsettling discoveries, occasional jump scares, and a creeping sense of dread in the darkness. Your companions are your only light. Stay close.

Features:
7 chapters of immersive psychological horror
Chilling encounters with a ghoul
Companions that illuminate your path with dynamic lights
Haunting music & atmospheric sound design
Choice-driven ending based on your emotional proximity
Unlockable chapter select after completion

FORMIDO: The darkness remembers who you walked with.
